title: Public Sepolia P6 stale-state defense, external tower finalization and cold recovery

sourceBinding.clientBasis: Root orchestration; the integrity export embeds the client SHA. Evidence packaging occurs afterward and is not the execution commit.
sourceBinding.deployedBasis: Parent-reported deployed runtime/tower source, corroborated by the failure excerpt. The deployed hub failed processing this run; the current client SHA was not deployed.

appointment.scope: The same pending appointment was retried after configuration repair. Only its public receipt/hash metadata is archived; no bundle or private pending/prepared file.

towerLaunchChange.scope: Launch RPC allowlist only; no source redeploy.
towerLaunchChange.validation: Root reports bash -n and the exact allowlist after PM2 restart passed.
towerLaunchChange.evidenceClass: Parent-reported remote tool output; no independently captured remote validation log is included.

startFalseNegative.meaning: The original start transaction succeeded. Read-only receipt/account evidence recovered the observation; the failed command was not treated as an on-chain revert.
startFalseNegative.resubmissionBasis: Parent execution report and the single original start hash retained throughout.

chain.units: Raw token units; no fiat/decimal conversion.
chain.realClock: Public Sepolia block timestamps; no local time warp in this run.

receipts.statusEvidence: Observer rejects missing/failed receipts or a sender other than the configured tower.
Observer rejects missing/failed receipts or a sender other than the configured tower.

finalChainObservation.verification: Pinned-block reads plus counter/final events matching the prepared latest proof hash and peer nonce; both transaction receipts must have status 1 and tower sender. The actual private prepared proof bundle is excluded.

coldRestore.scope: Independent offline reconstruction after recovery; these are persisted-state observations, not just the final live sample.

integrity.source: Root exported only allowlisted public result fields from the private recovered.json; the source private file was not opened or copied by this packager.
integrity.scope: 127 stored frames passed storage integrity checks through latestHeight 142; this is not a full external security audit or a separate replay gate.

transportTail.limitation: Financial finalization and local client cold recovery passed, but the deployed hub failed and the whole runtime/network was not quiescent. Account pendingFrame=false is not an empty global outbox. The separate deployed-hub excerpt records the production outage; no causal explanation of every WS error is assumed.

localCheck.scope: Local check on client source; not full CI or a full browser E2E suite.

remainingGates: Resolve deployed hub event-processing failures and verify recovery on the intended deployed candidate
Owner exception for frozen fixture imports

secretReview.includedPublicSeedField: DisputeStarted.watchSeed is already public on-chain event data, not a wallet/mesh signing seed.
secretReview.excluded: Private pending/prepared files, appointment bundle contents, signing/mesh seeds, private keys, raw WAL and profile directories.
secretReview.inspection: Targeted content review plus sensitive-assignment/path scan; no general secret-detection guarantee.

limitations: One concrete chain/tower/local-wallet P6 execution passed on the stated client/server/config combination, while the deployed hub failed. Neither entire production P6 nor mainnet readiness is established.
No new financial transaction was submitted by packaging; observations preserve both original operational failures.
Diagnostic commands reference ignored harnesses and private inputs intentionally excluded from the archive; they are provenance, not a standalone public reproducer.
Receipt/account-read inline commands absent from logs remain command:null; none was invented.
